description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerActivity controller class for the OpenCart platform. It handles displaying, saving configuration, and generating customer activity reports within the admin interface.

classes.name: CustomerActivity
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer activity reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including displaying the report page, saving settings, and retrieving report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer activity report form page with current settings and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings related to the customer activity report via POST request.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer activity report page with data retrieved from getReport().

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer activity list report as plain output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches filtered customer activity data, prepares pagination, and returns the report view as a string.
